How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Shipping timing depends on the delivery estimate shown at checkout, and once the order ships, the shipping confirmation email includes the tracking link.

If you have not received that email yet, the order may not have shipped yet, and tracking is only available after shipment.

If you want me to check the next step for your order, please send the email used at checkout and either your order ID or your ZIP code.

What should I do if the tracking never updates?

If tracking never updates, it can take 24 to 48 hours after label creation or between scan points for the carrier to post a new update, so checking the tracking link again after that window is the best next step.

If it still shows no movement after 48 hours, or if delivery is more than 3 days past the expected delivery window from the order date, it usually needs further review.
